text: Isoline contrast (lead, 2026-10-04): --isoline-ink becomes rgba(28,30,33,.9) and --isoline-case becomes rgba(255,255,255,.9), up from 0.8/0.7. A review sweep over every ramp fraction at map opacity 0.6, over sky, sand and blank, found the old worst case at 2.65:1 against the ground; the new tokens give 3.37:1 (WCAG non-text 3:1), with ink on casing at 11:1 or better. The test asserts ground contrast for the mapped case too.
